plugins.name: architecture
plugins.description: The architecture role on contract v3 (issue-160 round-3 promotion). Decides: 컴포넌트 경계·의존 방향.

plugins.name: arch-sequence-gate
plugins.description: Owns phase ordering (survey -> scout-brief-or-justified-skip -> proposal -> record) for the architecture role's contract-v3 loop. Fail-closed, existence-only. Kill switch: ARCH_SEQUENCE_GATE_OFF=1.

plugins.name: arch-citation-gate
plugins.description: Owns the sourcing norm: every architecture-role proposal/record claim phrased as external/industry knowledge must carry a URL or a Sources: entry. Shared across phase-1 and phase-2. Kill switch: ARCH_CITATION_GATE_OFF=1.

plugins.name: arch-adr-content-gate
plugins.description: Owns the ADR+C4 required-element norm for the architecture role's phase-2 record (docs/issue-<n>/reports/architecture.md). Migrated from architecture/hooks/adr-gate.sh. Kill switch: ARCH_ADR_CONTENT_GATE_OFF=1.

plugins.name: arch-phase1-checklist
plugins.description: Owns the repeated survey -> scout-brief -> proposal procedure for the architecture role's phase-1 work, as a checklist artifact. Documentation-only, no hook.
